# `csharp_new_line_before_members_in_object_initializers`

Put each member of an object initializer on its own line.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Example

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Point { public int X; public int Y; public int Z; }

public class Widget
{
    public Point Make() => new Point { X = 1, Y = 2, Z = 3 };
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Point { public int X; public int Y; public int Z; }

public class Widget
{
    public Point Make() => new Point { X = 1, Y = 2, Z = 3 };
}
```
:::

::::

*Curb recognises this key but does not yet reformat this construct — Before and After are identical.*
